review_description: Professional and friendly tradesmen. Rain forecast afternoon of 2nd day and additional workmen brought in to ensure all 28 panels were installed and roof work completed. Inverter was installed inside garage for added protection at no charge.

My home has a few unusal aspects that meant I needed more than just a 'sight unseen' quote. Delta Electrical and Solar came around to discuss the issues and promptly submitted two options.I made my decision and the system was installed very promptly. The installation took longer than I expected (due to the nature of the home), but the Delta team didn't rush anything. The result was a work of craftsmanship that would favourably stand comparison to any other system.Delta were very responsive and helpful when I had an issue with grid connection (even though it was my mistake, not theirs).I have since engaged Delta for other general electrical work and the results have been just as good. I highly recommend Delta Electrical and Solar.
